discovery_objective: Identify authoritative guidance on constructing Boolean concept blocks and assessing sensitivity/specificity/breadth/narrowness without arbitrary thresholds.
proposed_provider_class: Reporting-standard issuing body; systematic-review methods clearinghouse (class only, no name selected)
query_concept_block: concept block construction; search sensitivity and specificity; breadth-narrowness tradeoff
prohibited_assumptions: Do not assume any single named guideline is authoritative without verifying issuing-body identity; do not assume PRISMA scope automatically covers search-string construction detail.
expected_evidence_fields: issuing body; publication/update date; scope statement; recommended practice; stated limitations
provenance_requirement: Exact section/page or URL fragment supporting the specific claim used for component K6-01/K6-02/K6-06.
stop_condition: Stop and mark REQUIRES_REVIEW if the only located guidance is a secondary summary rather than an official source document.

discovery_objective: Identify authoritative reporting standards for complete, reproducible search strategies and for documenting filter rationale/recall consequences.
proposed_provider_class: Reporting-standard issuing body (class only, no name selected)
query_concept_block: reproducible search reporting; filter documentation and recall-consequence disclosure
prohibited_assumptions: Do not assume a reporting checklist implies the underlying search design is methodologically valid; reporting completeness and design validity are separate questions.
expected_evidence_fields: issuing body; checklist/standard version; required reporting elements; stated scope boundary
provenance_requirement: Exact checklist item or section supporting the specific claim used for component K6-05/K6-09.
stop_condition: Stop and mark REQUIRES_REVIEW if the standard only covers reporting format and explicitly disclaims search-design guidance.

discovery_objective: Identify authoritative guidance on structured peer review of a drafted search strategy prior to execution.
proposed_provider_class: Search-strategy peer-review guidance issuer (class only, no name selected)
query_concept_block: structured peer review of search strategies; independent second-reviewer verification
prohibited_assumptions: Do not assume informal internal review satisfies structured peer-review guidance; do not assume this class overlaps fully with SYSTEMATIC_REVIEW_SEARCH_GUIDELINE without verifying it addresses review process specifically.
expected_evidence_fields: issuing body; review-instrument name/version; review criteria list; applicability scope
provenance_requirement: Exact review-criteria item supporting the specific DEC-06 use case (all nine components as a peer-reviewable unit).
stop_condition: Stop and mark REQUIRES_REVIEW if located guidance addresses peer review of the overall review protocol only, not the search strategy specifically.

discovery_objective: Verify, per applicable family-source pair, whether the proposed Boolean/field-code/wildcard/proximity syntax matches each provider's own official documentation.
proposed_provider_class: Each of the 6 in-scope providers individually (class only; no provider named beyond those already in SLR_SEARCH_SOURCE_REGISTRY.csv)
query_concept_block: field-code syntax; boolean operator syntax; wildcard/truncation syntax; proximity operator syntax, per provider
prohibited_assumptions: Do not infer one provider's syntax from another's; do not treat a third-party tutorial as equivalent to official documentation.
expected_evidence_fields: provider name; documentation version/date; exact syntax rule; supported operators; documented limitations
provenance_requirement: Exact help-page section or documentation anchor for each verified operator per provider; one provenance record per (family, source) pair actually tested.
stop_condition: Stop and mark a given (family,source) pair REQUIRES_REVIEW if official documentation cannot be located or is ambiguous; do not infer verification from partial documentation.

discovery_objective: Identify authoritative guidance on cross-language term equivalence verification for scholarly search (Dutch/German/French/Indonesian translated-concept candidates).
authoritative_source_type: Institutional or professional-body multilingual-IR methodological guidance
proposed_provider_class: Multilingual information-retrieval guidance issuer (class only, no name selected)
query_concept_block: cross-language concept equivalence verification; translated-term false-friend risk; multilingual controlled vocabulary
prohibited_assumptions: Do not assume a machine-translation confidence score constitutes scholarly equivalence verification; do not assume English-language guidance generalizes to Dutch/German/French/Indonesian without checking language-pair-specific caveats.
expected_evidence_fields: issuing body; guidance scope (language pairs covered); verification method recommended; stated limitations
provenance_requirement: Exact section supporting the equivalence-verification method applied to the 11 REQUIRES_REVIEW term-variant rows.
stop_condition: Stop and mark REQUIRES_REVIEW if guidance addresses machine-translation quality generally but not scholarly-term equivalence specifically.

discovery_objective: Identify authoritative guidance specific to bibliographic search methodology in the humanities (as distinct from biomedical/social-science systematic-review search norms the SLR protocol otherwise draws on).
proposed_provider_class: Humanities/DH bibliographic-methods guidance issuer (class only, no name selected)
query_concept_block: humanities-specific search and citation-tracking practice; non-database discovery methods (citation chaining, hand-searching)
prohibited_assumptions: Do not assume biomedical systematic-review search norms transfer unmodified to humanities historiography; do not assume citation-chaining alone satisfies systematic-search reproducibility requirements.
expected_evidence_fields: issuing body; disciplinary scope; recommended supplementary discovery methods; stated limitations relative to database-only search
provenance_requirement: Exact section supporting any humanities-specific supplementary discovery method proposed for the C1-C6 families.
stop_condition: Stop and mark REQUIRES_REVIEW if guidance is discipline-general rather than humanities-specific.

discovery_objective: Identify authoritative guidance on using a small known-item/seed-study set to sanity-check a search strategy's sensitivity without claiming exhaustive recall.
proposed_provider_class: Search-validation methodology issuer (class only, no name selected)
query_concept_block: known-item search validation; seed-study sensitivity check; recall-estimate caveats
prohibited_assumptions: Do not assume a seed-study check establishes total recall; do not assume the seed set itself already exists (it does not; SLR-DEC-08 is separate and not yet applicable).
expected_evidence_fields: issuing body; validation-method description; recommended seed-set size guidance (if any, reported descriptively only, not adopted as a rule here); stated limitations
provenance_requirement: Exact section describing the validation method to be applied once a seed-study set exists.
stop_condition: Stop and mark REQUIRES_REVIEW if guidance presumes a seed set is already validated bibliographic ground truth for this specific review topic.

discovery_objective: Identify authoritative guidance on how and when a search strategy may be amended after a pilot run, and how such amendments should be versioned and disclosed.
proposed_provider_class: Search-amendment/versioning guidance issuer (class only, no name selected)
query_concept_block: post-pilot amendment protocol; version-controlled search-strategy disclosure; rationale documentation for changes
prohibited_assumptions: Do not assume any amendment is permissible without documented rationale; do not assume version history alone satisfies transparency requirements without an explicit change-rationale field.
expected_evidence_fields: issuing body; amendment-protocol description; required disclosure elements; stated limitations
provenance_requirement: Exact section describing amendment/versioning requirements to be applied to any future C1-C6 revision.
stop_condition: Stop and mark REQUIRES_REVIEW if guidance covers protocol amendments generally but not search-strategy amendments specifically.
